description: Makes an X (Twitter) share link. Use when the user wants to post or reply on X. Needs text; url, hashtags, via and in_reply_to are optional. Counts characters the way X does and sets is_within_free_limit to false when the post is over 280 characters (only X Premium can post it, so offer a shorter version). Returns an x.com link that opens the composer with the post filled in, and the user posts it. Nothing is posted or stored.

hashtags.description: Optional hashtags without the # sign, such as ["devtools", "opensource"].

in_reply_to.description: Optional numeric ID of the post to reply to, the digits at the end of its URL, such as "1850000000000000000". Not the full URL.

text.description: Post text (at most 25,000 characters), such as "We shipped our new CLI today!". Standard accounts can post up to 280 characters; X Premium up to 25,000.

url.description: Optional web link to attach, such as "https://example.com". X counts it as 23 characters.

via.description: Optional X username to credit, without the @ sign, such as "openkrill".

name: create_x_post

character_count.description: Estimated effective character count on X.

is_within_free_limit.description: True if within the 280-character free limit.

notes.description: Short notes to pass on to the user, including any warning.

status.description: Always ok when the link was made. Bad input returns an error instead.

url_length.description: Total length of the generated intent URL.

warning.description: Warning if text exceeds free character limit or safe URL limits.

title: Create X post
